verses.uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا
verses.indopak: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرْوًاۙ
verses.transliteration: ﻿waalththariyati tharwan
verses.saheeh: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
verses.khattab: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the scatterers, the winds that scatter dust and other things, that scatter (dharwan is a verbal noun; one may also say, tadhrīhi dharyan, ‘it blows it [sweeping it] away’);
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai un hawaon ki jo gard (dust) udane wali hain

verses.uthmani: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا
verses.indopak: فَالْحٰمِلٰتِ وِقْرًاۙ
verses.transliteration: faalhamilati wiqran
verses.saheeh: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.khattab: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and those that bear, the clouds that bear moisture [as], a burden (wiqran is the direct object of al-hāmilat, ‘those that bear’);
verses.romanUrdu: Phir pani se ladeh huey badal uthane wali hain

verses.uthmani: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا
verses.indopak: فَالْجٰرِيٰتِ يُسْرًاۙ
verses.transliteration: faaljariyati yusran
verses.saheeh: And those [ships] sailing with ease
verses.khattab: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and those that run, the ships that run upon the surface of the water, with ease (yusran is a verbal noun functioning as a circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, muyassaratan);
verses.romanUrdu: Phir subuk raftari (smoothly speed along) ke saath chalne wali hain

verses.uthmani: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
verses.indopak: فَالْمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمْرًاۙ
verses.transliteration: faalmuqassimati amran
verses.saheeh: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
verses.khattab: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and those that apportion by command: the angels who distribute provisions and the rains and other things across the lands and to [all] servants,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir ek baday kaam (barish) ki taqseem karne wali hain

verses.uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ
verses.indopak: اِنَّمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ
verses.transliteration: innama too'adoona lasadiqun
verses.saheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
verses.khattab: Indeed, what you are promised is true
verses.jalalayn: ﻿assuredly what you are promised (mā, ‘what’, relates to the verbal action), in other words, the promise given to them of resurrection and other matters, is true, is indeed a true promise,
verses.romanUrdu: Haqq yeh hai ke jis cheez ka tumhein khauf dilaya ja raha hai woh sacchi hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
verses.indopak: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيْنَ لَوٰ قِعٌۗ
verses.transliteration: wainna alddeena lawaqi'un
verses.saheeh: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
verses.khattab: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and assuredly judgement, requital after the reckoning, will take place!, without doubt.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jazaa-e-aamal (recompense) zaroor pesh aani hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
verses.indopak: وَالسَّمَاۤءِ ذَاتِ الْحُـبُكِۙ
verses.transliteration: waalssamai thati alhubuki
verses.saheeh: By the heaven containing pathways,
verses.khattab: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And by the heaven with all its tracks (hubuk is the plural of habīka, similar [in pattern and meaning] to turuq, tarīqa, ‘paths’), that is to say, [by the heaven] that is created with tracks similar to tracks made in the sand,
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai muttafarriq shakalon(numerous forms) waley aasmaan ki

verses.uthmani: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّـكُمْ لَفِىْ قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍۙ
verses.transliteration: innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
verses.khattab: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿indeed you, O people of Mecca, with regard to the matter of the Prophet (s) and the Qur'an, are of differing opinions: some say [of the Prophet that he is] ‘a poet’, ‘a sorcerer’, or ‘a soothsayer’, and [of the Qur'an, that it is] ‘poetry’, ‘sorcery’, or ‘soothsaying’.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aakhirat ke barey mein) tumhari baat ek durse se mukhtalif hai

verses.uthmani: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
verses.indopak: يُّـؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ اُفِكَۗ
verses.transliteration: yufaku 'anhu man ofika
verses.saheeh: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
verses.khattab: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He is turned away therefrom, from the Prophet (s) and the Qur'an, that is, [turned away] from believing therein, who has deviated, [who has been] turned away from guidance in God’s, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Ussey wahi bargashta (deluded/averse) hota hai jo haqq se phira hua hai

verses.uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.indopak: قُتِلَ الْخَـرّٰصُوْنَۙ
verses.transliteration: qutila alkharrasoona
verses.saheeh: Destroyed are the falsifiers
verses.khattab: Condemned are the liars—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Perish the conjecturers, accursed be the liars, those of differing opinions,
verses.romanUrdu: Maarey gaye qayas-o-gumaan (conjecturers) se hukum lagane wale

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِىْ غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُوْنَۙ
verses.transliteration: allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
verses.saheeh: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
verses.khattab: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who are in a stupor, in ignorance that has stupefied them, heedless, oblivious of the matter of the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo jihalat(ignorance) mein garq aur gaflat mein madhosh hain

verses.uthmani: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.indopak: يَسْـَٔــلُوْنَ اَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّيْنِۗ
verses.transliteration: yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
verses.saheeh: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
verses.khattab: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They ask, the Prophet, asking [him] derisively: ‘When is the Day of Judgement?’, in other words, ‘when will it come?’, and the response [given] to them is that it will come:
verses.romanUrdu: Puchte hain aakhir woh roz-e-jaza kab aayega

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yawma hum 'ala alnnari yuftanoona
verses.saheeh: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿on the day when they will be tormented in the Fire, that is to say, chastised in it, and it will be said to them during the chastisement:
verses.romanUrdu: Woh us roz aayega jab yeh log aag par tapaye jayenge

verses.uthmani: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
verses.indopak: ذُوْقُوْا فِتْنَتَكُمْۗهٰذَا الَّذِىْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tasta'jiloona
verses.saheeh: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Taste this torment of yours, this chastisement of yours. This, chastisement, is what you sought to hasten on!’, in the world in derision.
verses.romanUrdu: (Insey kaha jayega) ab chakkho maza apne fitne ka, yeh wahi cheez hai jiske liye tum jaldi macha rahey thay

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِىْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍۙ
verses.transliteration: inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wa'uyoonin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly the God-fearing will be amid gardens, orchards, and springs, flowing therein,
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta muttaqi log us roz baaghon(gardens) aur chashmo (fountains) mein hongey

verses.uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚإِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اٰخِذِيْنَ مَاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمْ رَبُّهُمْۗاِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِيْنَۗ
verses.transliteration: akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
verses.saheeh: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
verses.khattab: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿receiving (ākhidhīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person of the predicate of inna, ‘truly’) what their Lord has given them, of reward, for indeed formerly, [before] their entering Paradise, they had been virtuous, in the world.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo kuch unka Rubb unhein dega usey khushi khushi le rahey hongey. Woh us din ke aane se pehle neikukar (doers of good) thay

verses.uthmani: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: كَانُوْا قَلِيْلًا مِّنَ الَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahja'oona
verses.saheeh: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verses.khattab: they used to sleep only little in the night
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Little of the night did they use to sleep (mā is extra; yahja‘ūna is the predicate of kānū; qalīlan, ‘little’, is an adverb), in other words, they used to sleep for a small portion of the night and perform prayers during most of it,
verses.romanUrdu: Raaton(nights) ko kam hi sotey(sleep) thay

verses.uthmani: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَبِالْاَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
verses.saheeh: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
verses.khattab: and pray for forgiveness before dawn
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and at dawns they used to seek forgiveness: they used say, ‘Our Lord! Forgive us’,

wbw.translation: And in the hours before dawn

verses.romanUrdu: Phir wahi raat ke pichle peharon mein maafi maangte thay

verses.uthmani: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْۤ اَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّاۤٮِٕلِ وَالْمَحْرُوْمِ
verses.transliteration: wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
verses.saheeh: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
verses.khattab: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and there was a share in their wealth [assigned] for the beggar and the deprived, [the latter being] the one who does not beg, because of his self-restraint.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke maalon(wealth) mein haqq tha saahil( maangne waley) aur mehroom(destitute) ke liye

verses.uthmani: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَفِى الْاَرْضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلْمُوْقِنِيْنَۙ
verses.transliteration: wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
verses.saheeh: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.khattab: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And in the earth, in the way of mountains, seas, trees, fruits, plants and other things, there are signs, indications of God’s power, glory be to Him, exalted be He, and of His Oneness, for those who know with certainty,
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen mein bahut si nishaniyan hain yaqeen laney walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚأَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْۤ اَنْفُسِكُمْۗاَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
verses.saheeh: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
verses.khattab: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and in your souls, there are also signs, from the beginning of your creation to its end, and in the marvelous aspects of your creation. Will you not then perceive?, [all] that and thus infer therefrom the Creator of it and His power.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur khud tumhare apne wajood mein hain, kya tumko soojhta nahin

verses.uthmani: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَفِى السَّمَاۤءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wafee alssamai rizqukum wama too'adoona
verses.saheeh: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
verses.khattab: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And in the heaven is your provision, that is, the rain from which results the vegetation that is [your] provision, and [there is also] what you are promised, in the way of [the ultimate] return, reward and punishment, in other words, all of this is foreordained in the heaven.
verses.romanUrdu: Aasman hi mein hai tumhara rizq bhi aur woh cheez bhi jiska tumse waada kiya ja raha hai

verses.uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.indopak: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَـقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَاۤ اَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
verses.saheeh: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
verses.khattab: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it, that which you are promised, is as assuredly true as [the fact] that you have [power of] speech (read mithlu, in the nominative, as an adjective, with the mā being extra; or read mithla, in the accusative, as being a compound with mā), that is to say: [it is as true] as your speech is in reality, that is, in your knowing it to be [true] necessarily by its issuing from you.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas kasam hai aasmaan aur zameen ke maalik ki, yeh baat haqq hai, aisi hi yaqeeni jaise tum bol rahey ho

verses.uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
verses.indopak: هَلْ اَتٰٮكَ حَدِيْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ الْمُكْرَمِيْنَۘ
verses.transliteration: hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
verses.saheeh: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
verses.khattab: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has the story reached you — addressing the Prophet (s) — of Abraham’s honoured guests? — these were [said to be either] twelve, ten or three angels, one of whom was Gabriel.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi, Ibrahim ke muazzaz mehmano ki hiqayat bhi tumhein pahunchi hai

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖقَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًاۗقَالَ سَلٰمٌۚقَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ith dakhaloo 'alayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
verses.saheeh: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When (idh is an adverbial qualifier of hadīthu dayfi, ‘the story of the guests’) they entered upon him and said, ‘Peace!’ — in other words [they said] these very words. He said, ‘Peace!’ — [also] these very words — [These are] an unfamiliar folk, whom we do not know — he said this to himself (qawmun munkarūna is the predicate of an implicit subject such as hā’ūlā’i, ‘these are’).
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh uske haan (yahan) aaye to kaha aapko salaam hai. Usne kaha “ aap logon ko bhi salaam hai kuch na-aashna se log hain”

verses.uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ
verses.indopak: فَرَاغَ اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهٖ فَجَاۤءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِيْنٍۙ
verses.transliteration: faragha ila ahlihi fajaa bi'ijlin sameenin
verses.saheeh: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
verses.khattab: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he went aside to his family, secretly, and brought a fat calf — in sūrat Hūd [it is said], a roasted calf [Q. 11:69] —
verses.romanUrdu: Phir woh chupke se apne ghar walon ke paas gaya, aur ek mota taaza bachda (calf) laa kar

verses.uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَقَرَّبَهٗۤ اِلَيْهِمْۚقَالَ اَلَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
verses.saheeh: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
verses.khattab: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and he placed it near them saying, ‘Will you not eat?’: he invited them to eat, but they did not respond.
verses.romanUrdu: Mehmanon ke aage pesh kiya. Usne kaha aap hazraat khate nahin

verses.uthmani: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖوَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
verses.indopak: فَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيْفَةًۗقَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْۗوَبَشَّرُوْهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin 'aleemin
verses.saheeh: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
verses.khattab: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he conceived, he kept secret in himself, a fear of them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid!’, we are messengers from your Lord. And they gave him good tidings of [the birth of] a knowledgeable boy, one endowed with much knowledge, and this was Isaac, as mentioned in sūrat Hūd [Q. 11:71].

wbw.translation: and they gave him glad tidings

verses.romanUrdu: Phir woh apne dil mein unse dara. Unhon ne kaha dariye nahin, aur usey ek zee-ilm ladke ki paidaish ka mushda (good news/basharat) sunaya

verses.uthmani: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ
verses.indopak: فَاَقْبَلَتِ امْرَاَتُهٗ فِىْ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوْزٌ عَقِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat 'ajoozun 'aqeemun
verses.saheeh: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
verses.khattab: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then his wife, Sarah, came forward clamouring, shouting (fī sarratin is a circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, she came shouting) and smote, slapped, her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman!’, who has never given birth to a child, aged ninety-nine, with Abraham being one hundred years old; or [alternatively] he was a hundred and twenty years old and she was ninety years old.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh sunkar uski biwi cheekhti hui aage badhi aur usne apna mooh peeth liya aur kehne lagi, “boodhi baanj”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖإِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا كَذٰلِكِۙقَالَ رَبُّكِۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
verses.khattab: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘So, just like what we have said with regard to the good tiding, has your Lord said. Indeed He is the Wise, in His actions, the Knower’, of His creatures.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “yahi kuch farmaya hai tere Rubb ne. Woh hakeem hai aur sab kuch jaanta hai

verses.uthmani: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
verses.saheeh: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.khattab: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘So what is your business, O you who have been sent [by God]?’
verses.romanUrdu: Ibrahim ne kaha “aey farstaadgaan-e-ilaahi (envoys), kya mohim aapko dar-pesh hai

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُـوْۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرْسِلْنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَۙ
verses.transliteration: qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
verses.saheeh: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.khattab: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘Lo! we have been sent to a guilty folk, disbelievers — these were the people of Lot —
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne kaha “hum ek mujrim qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain

verses.uthmani: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ
verses.indopak: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ طِيْنٍۙ
verses.transliteration: linursila 'alayhim hijaratan min teenin
verses.saheeh: To send down upon them stones of clay,
verses.khattab: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that we may unleash upon them stones of clay, baked in fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke uspar paki hui mitti ke patthar (clay-stones) barsa de

verses.uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.indopak: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeena
verses.saheeh: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
verses.khattab: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿marked, bearing the name of the person at whom it will be hurled, by your Lord (‘inda rabbika is an adverbial qualifier of musawwamatan, ‘marked’) for [the destruction of] the prodigal’, for coming unto males in addition to their disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo aapke Rubb ke haan hadd se guzar jane walon ke liye nishan zada hain”

verses.uthmani: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
verses.saheeh: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
verses.khattab: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We brought forth those in them, that is, [in] the towns of the people of Lot, who were believers, in order to destroy the disbelievers;
verses.romanUrdu: Phir humne un sab logon ko nikal liya jo us basti mein momin thay

verses.uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيْهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
verses.saheeh: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
verses.khattab: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but We did not find therein other than one house of those who had submitted [to God]: these were Lot and his two daughters. They have been described [here] with [the terms] ‘belief’ and ‘submission’ because they had affirmed [faith] in their hearts and used their limbs to perform acts of obedience.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur wahan humne ek ghar ke siwa musalmano ka koi ghar na paya

verses.uthmani: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
verses.indopak: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيْهَاۤ اٰيَةً لِّـلَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَۗ
verses.transliteration: watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona al'athaba alaleema
verses.saheeh: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.khattab: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We left therein, after destroying the disbelievers, a sign, an indication of their destruction, for those who fear the painful chastisement, so that they may not do what these [sinners] did.
verses.romanUrdu: Uske baad humne wahan bas ek nishani un logon ke liye chodh di jo dardnaak azaab se darte hon

verses.uthmani: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْ مُوْسٰۤی اِذْ اَرْسَلْنٰهُ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila fir'awna bisultanin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [a sign too] in Moses (wa-fī Mūsā is a supplement to fīhā, ‘therein’), that is to say, We also left a sign in the story of Moses, when We sent him to Pharaoh, vested, with a clear warrant, with a manifest proof;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Moosa ke qissey mein jab humne usey sareeh sanad (clear authority) ke saath Firoun ke paas bheja

verses.uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
verses.indopak: فَتَوَلّٰى بِرُكْنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ
verses.transliteration: fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.saheeh: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
verses.khattab: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but he turned away, he rejected belief, to his supports (bi-ruknihi), his hosts, [so called] because to him they are like a support [rukn], saying, to Moses that he [Moses] was: ‘A sorcerer, or a madman!’
verses.romanUrdu: To woh apne bal-bootay par akad gaya aur bola yeh jaadugar hai ya majnoon(deewana) hai

verses.uthmani: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
verses.indopak: فَاَخَذْنٰهُ وَجُنُوْدَهٗ فَنَبَذْنٰهُمْ فِى الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيْمٌۗ
verses.transliteration: faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
verses.saheeh: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
verses.khattab: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We seized him and his hosts and cast, flung, them into the waters, the sea, and so they drowned, for he, that is, Pharaoh, was blameworthy, guilty of what is blameworthy, such as denying the messengers and claiming divinity.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir-e-kaar humne usey aur uske lashkaron ko pakda aur sabko samandar mein phenk diya aur woh malamat zadah hokar reh gaya

verses.uthmani: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْ عَادٍ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيْحَ الْعَقِيْمَۚ
verses.transliteration: wafee 'adin ith arsalna 'alayhimu alrreeha al'aqeema
verses.saheeh: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
verses.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [also] in, the destruction of, ‘Ād, was a sign, when We unleashed against them a barren wind, [a wind] which brings nothing of good, for it does not bear any rain and does not pollinate any trees; this [wind] was the west wind (al-dabūr).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Aad (people of Aad) mein, jabke humne unpar ek aisi hi bay-khair(devastating) hawa bhej di

verses.uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.indopak: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِۗ
verses.transliteration: ma tatharu min shayin atat 'alayhi illa ja'alathu kaalrrameemi
verses.saheeh: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
verses.khattab: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It did not leave anything, any soul or property, that it came upon without making it like decayed bones, like something that is withered and in scattered pieces.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke jis cheez par bhi woh guzar gayi usey boseeda (rotten) karke rakh diya

verses.uthmani: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْ ثَمُوْدَ اِذْ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوْا حَتّٰى حِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamatta'oo hatta heenin
verses.saheeh: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
verses.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [also] in, the destruction of, Thamūd, was a sign, when it was said to them, after the hamstringing of the she-camel, ‘Enjoy [yourselves] for a while!’, until the end of your terms [of life] — as stated in the [other] verse, ‘Enjoy [yourselves] in your dwellings for three days’ [Q.11:65].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Samood mein, jab unse kaha gaya tha ke ek khaas waqt tak mazey karlo

verses.uthmani: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.indopak: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَ هُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: fa'ataw 'an amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssa'iqatu wahum yanthuroona
verses.saheeh: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
verses.khattab: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then they defied, they scorned, the command of their Lord, [refraining] from implementing it; so the thunderbolt, that is, the destructive cry, seized them, after the three days had passed, as they were looking around, in other words, [it seized them] in the daytime.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar is tambeeh(warning) par bhi unhon ne apne Rubb ke hukum se sartabi (brazenly disobey) ki. Aakhir-e-kar unke dekhte dekhte ek achanak toot padne waley azaab ne unko aa liya

verses.uthmani: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.indopak: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوْا مُنْتَصِرِيْنَۙ
verses.transliteration: fama istata'oo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
verses.saheeh: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
verses.khattab: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they were unable to rise up, they could not get up upon the sending down of the chastisement, nor were they victors, over the One Who destroyed them.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir na unmein uthne ki sakat thi aur na woh apna bachao kar sakte thay

verses.uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖإِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُۗاِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
verses.saheeh: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
verses.khattab: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the people of Noah (read wa qawmi Nūhin, as a supplement to Thamūda, in other words: ‘in the destruction of these [two peoples] by what [destructive power] exists in the heavens and the earth there is [also] a sign’; or read wa qawma Nūhin, in other words, ‘We also destroyed the people of Noah’) aforetime, that is, before the destruction of those mentioned. Indeed they were an immoral lot.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur in sabse pehle humne Nooh ki qaum ko halaak kiya kyunke woh fasiq (wicked) log thay

verses.uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ السَّمَاۤءَ بَنَيْنٰهَا بِاَيْٮدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوْسِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosi'oona
verses.saheeh: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
verses.khattab: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the heaven, We built it with might, and indeed We are powerful (one says āda’l-rajulu or ya’īdu, to mean, ‘he is strong’; and awsa‘a’l-rajulu, to mean, ‘he has become capable [dhū sa‘a] and strong’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aasman ko humne apne zoar se banaya hai aur hum iski qudrat rakhte hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالْاَرْضَ فَرَشْنٰهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمٰهِدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waalarda farashnaha fani'ma almahidoona
verses.saheeh: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
verses.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the earth, We spread it out: We made it level: what excellent Spreaders then!, We are.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen ko humne bichaya hai aur hum badey acchey hamwar(Smoothers/ spread) karne waley hain

verses.uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni la'allakum tathakkaroona
verses.saheeh: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
verses.khattab: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And of all things (wa-min kulli shay’in is semantically connected to His [following] words khalaqnā) We created pairs, two kinds, such as male and female, heaven and earth, sun and moon, plain and mountain, summer and winter, sweet and bitter, light and darkness, that perhaps you might remember (tadhakkarūna: one of the two original tā’ letters [of tatadhakkarūna] has been omitted), and hence realise that the Creator of pairs is [Himself] Singular, that you might then worship him.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur har cheez ke humne jodey banaye hain, shayad ke tum ussey sabaq lo

verses.uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖإِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: فَفِرُّوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِۗاِنِّىْ لَـكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌۚ
verses.transliteration: fafirroo ila allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.khattab: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So flee unto God, that is to say, away from His punishment toward His reward by being obedient to Him and not disobeying Him. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him.
verses.romanUrdu: To daudo Allah ki taraf , main tumahre liye us ki taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

verses.uthmani: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖإِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۗاِنِّىْ لَـكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌۚ
verses.transliteration: wala taj'aloo ma'a allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.khattab: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And do not set up another god alongside God. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him (before fa-firrū, ‘so flee’, one may read an implicit [preceding] qul lahum, ‘Say to them’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na banao Allah ke saath koi dusra mabood. Main tumahre liye uski taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

verses.uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
verses.indopak: كَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَتَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌۚ
verses.transliteration: kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.saheeh: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
verses.khattab: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus there did not come to those who were before them any messenger but they said, that he was: ‘A sorcerer, or a madman!’, in other words, their denial of you, by saying that you are a sorcerer or a madman, was like the denial of communities before them of their messengers by saying that [same thing].
verses.romanUrdu: Yunhi hota raha hai, inse pehle ki qaumon ke paas bhi koi Rasool aisa nahin aaya jisey unhon ne yeh na kaha ho ke yeh saahir (sorcerer) hai ya majnoon(deewana)

verses.uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚبَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
verses.indopak: اَتَوَاصَوْا بِهٖۚبَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
verses.saheeh: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.khattab: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have they, all, enjoined this upon one another? (an interrogative intended as a denial). Nay, but they are an insolent folk, [a folk] whose own [proclivity to] insolence has made them all say the same thing.

wbw.translation: Have they transmitted it to them?

verses.romanUrdu: Kya in sab ne apas mein ispar koi samjhauta karliya hai? Nahin, balke yeh sab sarkash log hain

verses.uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ
verses.indopak: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَاۤ اَنْتَ بِمَلُوْمٍ
verses.transliteration: fatawalla 'anhum fama anta bimaloomin
verses.saheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
verses.khattab: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So shun them, for you will not be reproached, because you have conveyed the Message to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey Nabi, inse rukh pher lo, tumpar kuch malamat nahin

verses.uthmani: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَّذَكِّرْ فَاِنَّ الذِّكْرٰى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfa'u almumineena
verses.saheeh: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
verses.khattab: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And remind, admonish by the Qur'an, for reminding truly benefits believers, [these being] those whom God knows that they will believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta nasihat karte raho, kyunke nasihat imaan laney walon ke liye nafeh(faiyda-mand) hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
verses.indopak: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liya'budooni
verses.saheeh: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
verses.khattab: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they may worship Me: the fact that disbelievers do not worship [God] does not contradict this [statement], since a purpose does not have to be realised [in an act, for it to be valid], as when you may say: ‘I sharpened this pencil in order to write with it’, even though you might not actually write with it.
verses.romanUrdu: Maine Jinn aur Insano ko iske siwa kisi kaam ke liye paida nahin kiya hai ke woh meri bandagi karein

verses.uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
verses.indopak: مَاۤ اُرِيْدُ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ رِّزْقٍ وَّمَاۤ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّطْعِمُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yut'imooni
verses.saheeh: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
verses.khattab: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I do not desire from them any provision, [either] for Myself, for themselves, or for others, nor do I desire that they should feed Me, or [feed] themselves or others.
verses.romanUrdu: Main unsey koi rizq nahin chahta aur na yeh chahta hoon ke woh mujhey khilayein

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِيْنُ
verses.transliteration: inna allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
verses.khattab: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it is God Who is the Provider, the Lord of Strength, the Firm, the Stern.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah to khud hi Razzak hai, badi quwwat wala aur zabardast

verses.uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
verses.indopak: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ذَنُوْبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوْبِ اَصْحٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yasta'jiloona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
verses.khattab: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And for those who have wronged, their souls through disbelief, from among the people of Mecca and others, there will assuredly be a lot, a share of chastisement, like the lot, the share, of their counterparts, who perished before them. So let them not ask Me to hasten on, the chastisement, should I give them respite until the Day of Resurrection.

wbw.translation: so let them not ask Me to hasten.

verses.romanUrdu: Pas jin logon ne zulm kiya hai unke hissey ka bhi waisa hi azaab tayyar hai jaisa inhi jaise logon ko unke hissey ka mil chuka hai, iske liye yeh log jaldi na machayein

verses.uthmani: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: فَوَيْلٌ لِّـلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ يَّوْمِهِمُ الَّذِىْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yoo'adoona
verses.saheeh: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
verses.khattab: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For woe, a terrible chastisement [will come], to those who disbelieve, from, upon, that day of theirs which they are promised, that is, the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir ko tabahi hai kufr karne walon ke liye us roz jiska inhein khauff dilaya jaa raha hai
